# What happens when every team actually understands what's expected

No more ignored BEPs, invisible requirements or teams who never read the plan. Here's how organisations in 100+ countries made every team accountable for its part - in their own figures and their own words.

How owners and public clients got the information they asked for: requirements every appointed party could check against, and models checked before acceptance.

How contractors and VDC teams got every company agreeing its part up front, and replaced five tools with one.

How design teams traded spreadsheets for a plan every consultant agreed to, from Hungary to Hong Kong.

How consultants ran the same agreed, tracked process for every client, and grew without losing control.

How universities and national programmes taught ISO 19650 on live projects, and what it did for their students.

[Start free](https://app.plannerly.com/sign-up) [Book a live demo](https://plannerly.com/meeting/)

Free plan, no card needed. Trusted by nearly 150,000 teams in 100+ countries.
